tasks.detail: Builds the client with vite (vite build)

tasks.label: Cleanup Kilo Plans
tasks.detail: Archives all plans in .kilo/plans/ except the 10 latest by timestamp, moving them to .kilo/plans/archive/

tasks.label: Cleanup Kilo Sessions
tasks.detail: Removes all Kilo sessions except the 10 latest, keeping the most recent sessions active.

tasks.label: Docker Build & Push (GHCR)
args: $bn = if ($env:BUILD_NUMBER) { $env:BUILD_NUMBER } else { (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') }; docker login ghcr.io; docker build --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$bn -t ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:$bn -t ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:latest .; docker push ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:$bn; docker push ghcr.io/andymt/cardboard:latest
tasks.detail: Logs in to ghcr.io, builds and pushes image tagged with BUILD_NUMBER (defaults to timestamp) and latest
